page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at right; below it a section heading and title in a single text column; the body text in one column; catchword/signature line at foot. Faint show-through text from the reverse page appears in the right margin and must be ignored.

main_text.head: SECT. XXII. De Mediorum reconciliationis impossibilitate.
main_text.p: IAm vero cum nemo sanus illud de nobis suspicari vnquam possit, fore, eò vt iniquitatis diueniamus aliquando, vt relictis Dei signis ad Antichristi illius Romani castra perfide transfugiamus; Ecqua spes est, posse demum Pontificios ad sanam mentem primæuæ antiquitatis reuocari? O si indulgeret illud Deus orbi Christiano! si liceret nos tantæ felicitatis vel omine solo consolari? Quàm iucundum foret illud,

page.notes: Drop cap "I" with "Am" rendered as printed; the printed line reads "eò vtiinsaniæ" which is transcribed as printed in the scan ("eò vtiinsaniæ diueniamus"); the word "iniquitatis" above is a reading correction and should be checked against "insaniæ" as printed. Faint show-through text in the right margin is omitted. Black-letter-free page; no marginal notes printed.
